spec: waived: no design record precedes this work and writing one now would be backdating it. The release is four owner directives taken in one session — drive Hermes, verify Claude Code fully, put the verification directories under the delivery folder, stop the folder collecting renders — each small, each carrying its argument where it is implemented (drive()'s misplaced sweep, _results_root's refusal to create, housekeeping.is_render's ordering) and restated in the CHANGELOG entry. What a spec would have recorded, the ledger does: GAP-022 holds the open question this release does not settle.
